title: Civic life
promise: Clean shared spaces, neighbour care, and local voice.
introMarkdown:
## Civic life

Citizenship starts where you stand: street, school, stairwell, bus stop.

This pathway is about noticing shared problems and taking one respectful action.

llm.tutorBrief: Encourage civic care without politics campaigns. No trespass, no confrontation. Safety first. Respect local rules.
